name: Fields Pond Foundation Grants
summary: Private foundation grants to community-based nature and land conservation organisations in New England and upper New York State, with proposals accepted at any time.

geography.label: New England and upper New York State

eligibility.rule: Have IRS 501(c)(3) status and be classified as other than a private foundation

documents: Annual report, if one is published
Most recent IRS Form 990, if appropriate
Proof of IRS filing extension if the latest fiscal year’s submission deadline has passed
Current IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter showing it is not a private foundation
Project budget and funding sources, in a chart or spreadsheet if using the Common Grant Application
Maps of parcels to protect or access improvements, showing nearby conservation resources

status.quote: Proposals and concept papers may be submitted at any time, since the Directors meet regularly throughout the year.

applicant_types.quote: Assisting community-based nature and land conservation organizations.

geography.quote: Our regular grantmaking programs are presently limited to organizations in New England and upper New York State.

access.quote: One copy of your full proposal should be sent to the Foundation office by email.

window.quote: Proposals and concept papers may be submitted at any time, since the Directors meet regularly throughout the year.

amount.quote: The expected range of grants is $500 to $25,000, with most falling within the range of $2,000 to $15,000.

effort.quote: by submitting a one-page proposal outline
One copy of your full proposal should be sent to the Foundation office by email.
An incoming proposal is critically assessed to determine whether it meets current guidelines and interest.

eligibility.quote: Current copy of the tax exemption letter from the IRS under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, including the indication that the organization is "not a private foundation" under Section 509(a).

documents.quote: Board and staff rosters, and an indication of the capabilities of key staff to be involved in the proposed project. Current and projected operating budgets, the most recent financial statement, and an annual report (if one is published). Complete copy of the most recent IRS Form 990 (if appropriate to the organization)

Form 9325 which is generated at the time of filing (proof of acceptance by the IRS), and proof of extension if the latest fiscal year's submission deadline has passed. Current copy of the tax exemption letter from the IRS under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, including the indication that the organization is "not a private foundation" under Section 509(a).
Instead we request a budget chart or spreadsheet showing a detailed breakdown of expenses and potential funding sources.
Maps showing the parcels to be protected or access improvements planned, and their relationship to other nearby conservation resources.
The project's budget, a description and summary of other firm or likely sources of funding
